name: Tohidul Certificate Verification System
author: tohidulbhuiyan

sections.description:
Tohidul Certificate Verification System is a powerful yet easy-to-use WordPress plugin designed for educational institutions, training centers, and organizations to verify certificates online.

With this plugin, you can easily add student certificate data, manage them from a modern admin dashboard, and allow anyone to verify certificates using a registration or certificate number. It comes with a professional print-ready certificate template.

🚀 Key Features

  • Modern Admin Dashboard: Clean and responsive interface to manage all certificates.
  • Bulk Actions: Delete multiple certificates at once securely.
  • Frontend Verification: Simple shortcode [tcvs_verification] to display the search form.
  • Print Support: Students can print their verified certificates directly from the website without layout issues.
  • Import/Export: Easily import bulk student data from CSV or export data for backup.
  • Backup & Restore: Create full JSON backups of your database and restore them anytime.
  • Customizable Settings: Upload your Institute Logo, Authorized Signature, and Verified Seal directly from the settings panel.
  • Secure: Built with WordPress standard security practices (Nonce verification, Sanitization).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/tohidul-certificate-verification-system directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the [tcvs_verification] shortcode on any page to display the verification form.
  4. Go to Certificate Verification > Institute Settings to configure your institute details.
sections.faq:
How do I display the verification form?

Simply create a new page or edit an existing one and add the shortcode [tcvs_verification].

Can I import students from Excel?

Yes! Save your Excel file as a CSV format and use the Import/Export menu to upload student data in bulk.

How do I backup my data?

Go to the Backup/Restore menu. You can download a JSON file containing all certificate data.
